scenario:
Agent1 has just bought a unique and trendy dress for an upcoming social event. Agent2, a friend who is also attending the event, is shown the dress by Agent1. Both agents want to make a fashion statement at the event, but Agent1's new dress sets a high bar for Agent2.

The event is known for its fashion-forward attendees and the pressure is on to stand out.

Agent1 and Agent2 are friends, but they also share a friendly rivalry when it comes to fashion.
learner_goal: Your goal is to receive compliments on your fashion sense at the event. You want to make sure your dress remains the highlight, but you also don't want to overshadow your friendship with Agent2. <extra_info> Consider giving fashion advice to Agent2 that complements your dress without competing with it. </extra_info><clarification_hint> Keep in mind the theme of the event. </clarification_hint><strategy_hint> You can suggest accessories or color schemes that differ from your dress to help Agent2 stand out in their own way. </strategy_hint>
